description: This file contains the implementation of jQuery's event handling system, including event registration, removal, triggering, and normalization of event objects.

classes.name: jQuery.Event
classes.description: A wrapper for native DOM events, providing normalized properties and methods for event handling.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Attaches event handlers to elements, supporting multiple event types and delegation.

methods.name: one
methods.description: Attaches a one-time event handler to elements.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Triggers an event on elements, optionally with additional data.

methods.name: triggerHandler
methods.description: Triggers an event on the first element without bubbling.
